title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Misdeclaration Penalty and Inspection Recovery Tariff
content:
When containers under Dangerous Goods Acceptance are found carrying goods other than those declared, three tariff figures come into play: a penalty for each affected container, a ceiling on that penalty for the acceptance as a whole, and a flat recovery of inspection and handling cost. All amounts are in US dollars.

| Category | Penalty per affected container (USD) | Ceiling on the penalty per acceptance (USD) | Inspection and handling cost recovered (USD per acceptance) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 15000.00 | 75000.00 | 250.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 15000.00 | 75000.00 | 350.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 25000.00 | 125000.00 | 450.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 30000.00 | 150000.00 | 550.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 30000.00 | 150000.00 | 550.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 35000.00 | 175000.00 | 950.00 |

## How the figures relate

In every row the ceiling is five times the per-container penalty, so the ceiling is reached at the fifth affected container and further containers add nothing to the penalty. The inspection figure is a separate, single amount per acceptance and does not scale with the number of containers.
